verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a programmatic API (usable with orchestrators like Airflow) and explains how to get access tokens for it, so an API reference of some kind exists. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or has runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive API explorer, runnable or try-it examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
